text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Median over 20 synthetic systems built from the pilot's fitted Primaries, with the audit's multipliers and the Primaries' own autocorrelated noise in the BSP reading. Extra error is the mean absolute error minus the separate fits' (points of effective capacity; symmetric-logarithmic axis). Dashed line: the 0.023-point limit.'
text.tspan: Median over 20 synthetic systems built from the pilot's fitted Primaries, with the audit's
multipliers and the Primaries' own autocorrelated noise in the BSP reading. Extra error is the mean
absolute error minus the separate fits' (points of effective capacity; symmetric-logarithmic axis).
